```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

ps_intoASV <- Go_intoASV(
  psIN = ps2,
  project = project,
  #level = "Species",
  #target = "all",
  clustering_cutoff=0.995,
  similarity_cutoff=0.97,
  compute_ci = T,
  method = "nucdiv",     # 근사 계산 nucdiv  simple
  aligner = "DECIPHER",     # alignment 강화 DECIPHER
  min_asv = 3,           # ASV 수 3 이상만 계산
  min_abund = 10,        # 최소 풍부도 제한
  distance_gap = "exclude",
  weighting = "entropy" # entropy abundance
)

Go_clusterDiagnostics(project, cluster_map = "intoASV_CP_260102/intoASV/pi_tab/cluster_map_similarity_0.970_260102.csv")
```
